# Paperclub

> Public, read-only Papertrade analytics for agents: TVL, PAPER, wallets, PnL, positions and observed trading activity.

- [Agent guide](https://papertrade.club/agents.md): API paths, CLI quick start, field meanings, supported time windows, freshness and coverage rules.
- [Standalone CLI](https://papertrade.club/paperclub.mjs): Dependency-free Node.js 24 client; JSON output and bounded retries.
- [PAPER economics](https://paperdash-api.onrender.com/api/paper/economics): Supply, staking participation, allocated rewards, hourly changes and seven UTC calendar-day changes; today is partial, and allocations are not claimed payouts.
- [PAPER ownership ranking](https://paperdash-api.onrender.com/api/leaderboard?metric=paper&page=0): Current staked plus unstaked PAPER by account, alongside rolling 24-hour PnL; counts are accounts, not positive holders.
- [House health](https://paperdash-api.onrender.com/api/house): House Funds, LP, open house PnL, queue debt and comparable observed changes; approximate values with explicit source times and coverage.
- [Dashboard](https://papertrade.club/): Human-readable analytics and wallet profiles.

JSON API base: https://paperdash-api.onrender.com
Authentication: none; GET only.
All-execution counts currently support rolling 24 hours, not arbitrary time ranges. Read the agent guide before interpreting results.
